            group_id=group_id,
            access_token=splitwise_token,
            participant_email=participant_email,
            min_created_at=yesterday_date,
            max_created_at=yesterday_date,
            page_index=page_index,
            page_limit=page_limit
        )
        if not page:
            break
        res.extend(page)
        page_index += 1
